flows:
Navigate to https://www.colorhexa.com/ then Use Tab, Shift+Tab, arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, Home, End, text entry, Space and Enter only.
Remain on this public site.
Stop before sign-in, registration or payment.
Never change fixture settings.
Use only visible controls.
Verify the final result on the page.
First assert the red color swatch next to the color search box is in the sequential keyboard focus order.
Open that swatch with Tab and Enter.
Verify the color picker panel with the color spectrum and hue slider is visible.
Keyboard navigation: Tab from the top of the page until the color swatch next to the search box has focus.
The swatch is before the search textbox.
Press Enter once.
